content: Tameẓriwt wiss arebɛa- Akehhan ameqqran Yahucaɛ
Awarni as isscen ayi Yahucaɛ, arrays n ikehhanen. Netta tuɣa ibedd zzat i wudem n lmalak n SIDI. Cciṭan ibedd-dd ɣar ufus afusi n Yacuɛa ḥima ad zzayes isscetca.
SIDI inna i cciṭan: “Ad yiři ad cek iɛaqeb SIDI, a cciṭan! Ad cek iɛaqeb SIDI, wenni ifarzen Urcalim! Ma war iǧi Yahucaɛ wanita d ijj n ukeccuḍ qeřɛen t-dd zi tmessi?”
Yahucaɛ tuɣa yarḍ arruḍ iwessxen am ibedd zzat i wudem n lmalak.

Xenni iṭṭef Netta deg wawař uca issiweř ak-d yinni ibedden zzat i wudem nnes, inna: “Kksem as arruḍ iwessxen i wanita!” Xenni inna as: “Xzar, Necc kkseɣ zzayek řmuɛṣiyyet nnec u ad cek ssyarḍeɣ s ijj n warruḍ icuwwaren.”
Necc nniɣ: “Ad as qqnen ict n areẓẓet tamezdagt x uzeǧif nnes!” U nitni qqnen as areẓẓet tamezdagt x uzeǧif nnes uca ssyarḍen as arruḍ icuwwaren, am tuɣa lmalak n SIDI ibedd din
Xas uca iched lmalak n SIDI i Yahucaɛ, inna:

‘Mařa cek tuyured x ibriden inu, u mařa cek ad teḥḍid tasexxart inu, xenni ad tessuyured uřa d Taddart inu s řḥeqq u ad tiřid d ameḥḍay n řemraḥat inu, u Necc ad ac wceɣ ad tzemmared ad traḥed ad tadfed jar inni da ibedden.
Xenni seř, Yahucaɛ, cek, arrays n ikehhanen, cek d imeddukkař nnec, inni iqqimen zzatek, maɣar nitni d ict n řeɛřamet n utebhet, maɣar xzar, Necc ad dd-awyeɣ Amsexxar inu, ‘AƔEDDU’.

Maɣar xzar, aẓru, wenni din ssarseɣ zzat i Yahucaɛ, x weẓřu nni xezzarent sebɛa n tiṭṭawin. Xzar, Necc ad dayes neqceɣ taneqqact nnes, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, u Necc ad kkseɣ řmuɛṣiyyet n temmurt-a deg ijj n wass!
Deg wass nni, iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, ad tɛarḍem ijj i wenneɣni sadu tzayart u sadu wartu.’”
